description_en: Queries compliance evaluation results based on the rules in a compliance package in an account group
description_zh: 从指定账号组内规则的合规评估结果维度查询合规概要
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-resource-compliance-by-config-rule --compliance-type COMPLIANT --config-rule-id cr-d369626622af008e0000 --aggregator-id ca-a4e5626622af00790000 --resource-account-id 1009318965420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateResourceComplianceByConfigRule

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result of the resources. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is evaluated as compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is evaluated as incompliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to your resources.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No resource data is available
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of the account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resources in the account group belong.

You can use either the ResourceAccountId or ResourceOwnerId parameter. We recommend that you use the ResourceAccountId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
账号组内待查询资源所属的阿里云账号ID。
参数ResourceAccountId和ResourceOwnerId二选一，推荐使用本参数
parameters.name: resource_account_id

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation results of the resources. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource was evaluated as compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resource was evaluated as incompliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule did not apply to your resources.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No resource data was available
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

Count.description_en: The number of resources that have compliance evaluation results. For example, if the value of the `ComplianceType` parameter is `COMPLIANT`, this parameter value indicates the number of compliant resources
Count.description_zh: 资源数。例如：当`ComplianceType`为`COMPLIANT`时，表示评估结果为合规的资源数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of evaluated resources
